note: Every entry in pnpm-workspace.yaml auditConfig.ignoreGhsas must appear here with a named approval and an expiry. check:audit-exceptions blocks on an unregistered, incomplete or expired entry. An entry whose approval is still pending is printed as pending on every run; it does not become invisible.

approvers: repository owner, acting as both technical owner and security owner
exceptions.scope: Development-only resolution paths. Not reachable from a route, and no attacker-supplied glob reaches the affected expansion.
exceptions.reason: The affected older majors have no compatible published fix. The alternative is removing the parent packages, which would remove build and test tooling.
exceptions.releaseCondition: Remove this entry once the upstream older major publishes a fix, or once every parent package resolves to brace-expansion 5.x. Re-check on every dependency upgrade.
